updates.title: Powers of Federal Credit Unions
updates.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) is proposing to amend the NCUA's regulations regarding incidental powers to clarify that federal credit unions (FCUs) are not required to seek an advisory opinion from the NCUA's Office of General Counsel before petitioning the Board to engage in an activity that does not fall within an FCU's preapproved incidental powers.

updates.title: Corporate Credit Unions; Fidelity Bond and Insurance Coverage for Federally Insured Credit Unions
updates.summary: The NCUA Board (Board) seeks comment on proposed amendments to its regulations governing fidelity bond and insurance coverage for federally insured credit unions (FICUs). The proposed rule would eliminate certain prescriptive procedural mandates and simplify requirements for coverage amounts and deductibles. The intended effect is greater flexibility for FICUs, simplified compliance, and reduced administrative costs
